observed.caption: Aerial view of a city with a clock tower building complex in the foreground, a large green park with a lake in the center, and high-rise buildings and distant mountains in the background under a cloudy sky.
observed.description: The photo shows an elevated aerial view looking across a city. In the foreground is a large beige building complex with a tall central clock tower and multiple connected low-rise wings surrounded by trees, roads, and parking areas with numerous small vehicles. Behind the building complex lies a large urban park with expansive green grass fields including a rectangular sports field on the left, winding paved paths, dense scattered trees, and an irregular-shaped reflective lake near the center. Beyond the park is a dense urban area with mid-rise and high-rise buildings of varied heights and colors, interspersed with trees. In the far background a hazy blue-gray mountain range is visible on the horizon beneath a partly cloudy sky with white and gray clouds.
